domain.name: News and Current Events
domain.description: Breaking news, disasters, accidents, crime, investigations, human interest stories, local news, national news, international events, weather
domain.powerWords: breaking, shocking, urgent, hidden, revealed, crisis, exclusive, devastating, confirmed, alarming, unexpected, critical, essential, rare, unprecedented, pivotal, alarming

principles.principle: Lead with specific numbers and names — never vague labels
Vary your emotional angle: urgency, curiosity, empathy, surprise, concern — do NOT always use urgency
Frame events from different perspectives: human impact, systemic failure, historical context, what comes next
Some headlines should provoke thought, not just alarm — ask questions, challenge assumptions, reveal patterns
Use period-separated fragments sparingly — they lose power when overused
